topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I stumbled upon a time capsule, buried in the shadows of my forgotten past. It’s unsettling, this box, a vessel of unknown intentions. Layers of earth and time peel back, revealing something sealed with a purpose I cannot recall. Each item inside speaks in hushed, unfamiliar whispers. Photographs of faces that smile too brightly, notes scribbled in a hurried, younger hand. What did I hope to find, or perhaps forget, when I buried this? The air is thick with questions, each one more suffocating than the last. I feel the weight of the earth pressing down, not just on the capsule, but on my chest, as though it’s trying to keep everything buried for a reason.
